  SELECT 1998 as year, AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) as avg_weekly_wage FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q1` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL SELECT 1998, avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q2` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL SELECT 1998, avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL SELECT 1998, avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q4` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL SELECT 2017, avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q1` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL SELECT 2017, avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q2` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL SELECT 2017, avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
  UNION ALL SELECT 2017, avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q4` WHERE geoid = '42003'
),
wage_summary AS (
  SELECT year, AVG(avg_weekly_wage) as avg_annual_weekly_wage FROM wage_data GROUP BY year
),
cpi_data AS (
  SELECT year, value FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u` 
  WHERE area_name = 'Pittsburgh, PA' AND item_name = 'All items' AND year IN (1998, 2017) AND period = 'S03'
),
wage_1998 AS (SELECT avg_annual_weekly_wage FROM wage_summary WHERE year = 1998),
wage_2017 AS (SELECT avg_annual_weekly_wage FROM wage_summary WHERE year = 2017),
cpi_1998 AS (SELECT value as cpi FROM cpi_data WHERE year = 1998),
cpi_2017 AS (SELECT value as cpi FROM cpi_data WHERE year = 2017)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(w2.avg_annual_weekly_wage - w1.avg_annual_weekly_wage, w1.avg_annual_weekly_wage) * 100, 2) as wage_growth_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c2.cpi - c1.cpi, c1.cpi) * 100, 2) as cpi_growth_pct
FROM wage_1998 w1, wage_2017 w2, cpi_1998 c1, cpi_2017 c2
